allowed: validate the hash-bound request, authorization, product candidate, harness, lifecycle, sample, model binary identity and target aliases before driver creation
start one run-owned Windows-native Ollama and one run-owned temporary ComfyUI on literal loopback only
read the fixed non-private test image once and make one local gemma4:26b model call
perform exactly 24 planned public /prompt submissions, with a hard maximum of 26, for V0-A01/A03/A04/A05/A08 on the same candidate
use the system clipboard only for the bounded A04 copy checks and fail closed if unavailable
write only run-owned temporary exports and minimized evidence, then completely clean them
required_checks: public image route, controlled preprocessing, real raw response and PromptSpec suggestion
four output views plus schema-valid JSON/TXT with zero extra model calls
Ollama-stopped 20000-character manual copy/export and deterministic atomic-write failure
public state-owner invalid JSON, refusal, timeout, OOM and stale-token paths with unchanged draft bytes/epoch and retry_count zero
public unanalyzed empty manual export with no approval/content-note permission gate
GPU, no-cloud, loopback, model ledger, target pre/post integrity, owned terminal substates, post-cleanup and privacy recomputation
mandatory_stops: GPU preflight above 4096 MiB, runtime at or above 23552 MiB, pre-existing target process/listener, or any non-loopback connection
any public route, Oracle, fixed-denominator, export, state, privacy, evidence serialization, cleanup or target-integrity failure
any action would exceed the frozen one-shot budget
forbidden: cloud, paid service, download, upgrade, visible browser or remote Git push
permanent ComfyUI/Ollama configuration or target installation writes
use of media other than the hash-bound sample
termination of non-owned processes, retry under the same authorization, reuse of old evidence, or lowering the frozen denominator/Oracle
evidence_minimization: Persist aliases, hashes, public prompt/history facts, bounded outputs and owned-resource states only; do not persist media bytes, tensors/current_inputs, traceback, private absolute paths, secrets, unrelated process tables or raw command lines.
cleanup: Unload the model, prove /api/ps empty, re-prove owned listener lineage, stop only run-owned processes, remove run-owned temp/exports, prove ports/processes/temp absent and target alias maps equal.
expires_when: one terminal V0-S1 fixed-denominator checkpoint receipt is generated, the single effective image attempt is consumed, or any mandatory stop occurs
